description: Make a new sudoku with exactly one solution (easy, medium or hard; classic or diagonal), optionally with the answer. Seeded, so the same seed gives the same puzzle. More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

answers.description: With format=svg: draw the solution (default false).

seed.description: Whole number 0–4294967295. The same seed and options always give the same puzzle; leave it out for a random one (the response tells you the seed it used).

svg.description: Include SVG images of the puzzle and its solution in the JSON (default true).

variant.description: classic (default) or diagonal: both long diagonals must also hold 1-9 once each (sudoku X). Diagonal SVGs shade the two diagonals.

name: make_sudoku
title: Make a sudoku
